extras: The plugin bundles its dependencies (fzf-for-js) and supports both path insertion and opening the entry.
intentEvidence: It brings the muscle memory of shell fuzzy finders into the editor, without leaving Obsidian.
motivation: To bring the muscle memory of shell fuzzy finders into the editor, allowing seamless path insertion or opening without leaving Obsidian.
problem: Manually finding, copying, and pasting filesystem paths into notes is cumbersome and disruptive to the writing flow.
summary: Fuzzy-find any file or directory under a root, preview it, and insert its path at the cursor or open the entry.
